options.idea: Gorillas in Volcanoes NP, Nyungwe chimps, canopy walk, Kigali Genocide Memorial.
options.safety: Kigali, tourist circuits very safe. Level 3 from regional Ebola/Marburg, DRC conflict. Volcanoes NP near border zone; recheck Nov/Dec.
options.fit: Good: gorillas best exotic complement to Kenya savanna; short easy travel. Catch: Level 3, $1,500 permit.

options.idea: Simien geladas, Bale Ethiopian wolves, Lalibela churches; easy ADD-NBO flights.
options.advisory_level: Level 3: Reconsider Travel (DNT Amhara, Tigray, others)
options.safety: Simien, Gondar, Lalibela in Amhara: Do Not Travel (Fano conflict, kidnappings). Bale's Oromia has DNT pockets. Ethiopian Christmas Jan 7.
options.fit: Poor: superb wildlife, cheap flights, but best areas Do Not Travel. Addis plus Bale weak.

options.idea: Tarangire elephants, Ngorongoro Crater, Lake Manyara from Arusha; Nairobi 5–6h shuttle.
options.advisory_level: Level 3: Reconsider Travel (2025 election unrest; verify)
options.safety: Safari circuit running. Post-2025-election curfews, blackouts, protests, foreigner detentions. Watch anniversaries. Town crime; LGBTQ targeting flagged.
options.fit: Poor-to-OK: great wildlife but duplicates Kenya safari at higher fees. Better: add Ngorongoro to Kenya leg.

options.idea: Lemurs (indri at Andasibe, ~4h from Tana), chameleons, Ranomafana, Morondava baobabs.
options.advisory_level: Level 2: Exercise Increased Caution (lowered Dec 2025; verify)
options.safety: Fragile post-coup politics; Tana protests possible. Serious crime, night road banditry: never drive after dark. Rainy season, cyclones Jan–Mar.
options.fit: OK: most exotic, unique wildlife, but rains, slow roads, unreliable flights. Andasibe plus Tana fits 5h limit.

options.idea: Petra (2 days), Wadi Rum camp, Dana hiking, Dead Sea, Madaba Christmas.
options.safety: Tourist sites normally very safe. Level 3 regional: Iran missile/drone overflights, airspace closures possible. Avoid Syria/Iraq borders; recheck ceasefire.
options.fit: OK: dramatic desert, strong culture, drives ≤3h; weak wildlife. Airspace risk to Kenya connection.

options.idea: Wahiba Sands, Wadi Shab, Jebel Shams, Nizwa, Ras al Jinz turtles; self-drive.
options.safety: Traditionally very safe, low crime, good roads. New Level 3 (Aug 2026): Iranian drones/missiles. Gulf airspace closures could strand you.
options.fit: Poor: beautiful, easy travel, little wildlife beyond turtles. Recent advisory raise risks missing Dec 28 Kenya start.

options.idea: Sheikh Zayed Mosque, Louvre AD, Dubai souqs, desert oryx reserve; Emirates LAX-DXB-NBO.
options.safety: Very low street crime. Level 3: regional missile/drone risk, airspace disruption; DXB hub vulnerable. Christmas crowds, prices.
options.fit: Poor: minimal wildlife, priciest per day, same regional risk as Oman/Jordan. Only plus: easy flights.
